name: Thalia Amberhide
summary: At Freewind Post, Thalia Amberhide waits for Lakota Windsong to return safely. Her friend was taken by the Grimtotem clan in Thousand Needles.

sections.title: A Friend at the Post
sections.body: At Freewind Post, Thalia Amberhide waits for word of Lakota Windsong. Arnak Grimtotem and his kin captured her close companion. Thalia needs passing Horde travelers to search the canyon depths, free Lakota, and guide her back up the lifts to the mesa settlement.

faq.answer: Thalia Amberhide lives at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. She is a loyal friend to Lakota Windsong, a tauren caught up with the Grimtotem clan.

faq.q: Where can Thalia Amberhide be found?
faq.answer: Thalia Amberhide can be found on the high mesa at Freewind Post, in the middle of Thousand Needles. Wooden elevators carry travelers up from the canyon floor.

faq.q: What is Thalia's connection to Lakota Windsong?
faq.answer: Thalia Amberhide is a close friend of Lakota Windsong. After Arnak Grimtotem captures Lakota, Thalia welcomes travelers at Freewind Post who help Lakota escape her captors.

angles.text: As a tauren, you can help Thalia rescue Lakota and stand against the Grimtotem tribe's treachery. Their actions threaten your kin amid clan discord.
As a member of the Horde, you can help protect Freewind Post from Grimtotem aggression. It is a key Horde waypoint in Thousand Needles.
